README.md:
# FedSeq revised manuscript

The PDF has 12 body pages plus one reference page, six editable TikZ method diagrams, four experiment composites, three pseudocode algorithms, and 43 cited references.

Upload this directory to Overleaf with main.tex and pdfLaTeX, or run make locally. Tables and prose are generated from verified_statistics.json in the full experiment package. The protected-view theorem assumes ideal private sampling; it is not a full-system SGX privacy guarantee.

Table I reports noisy accuracy, Table II the unclustered control, and Table III current local encrypted transport. Raw outputs and recovery provenance are in the full code package.

ICDE_AI_DISCLOSURE.tex retains the actual assistance scope for adaptation to venue requirements and is not included in this working draft.

The third benchmark uses real Rfam-derived nucleotide matches, with simulated provider ownership. Its parameter figure is separate for readability; the full three-dataset comparison and ablation composites are in the complete project.
